skeleton: four-legged fawn standing, three-quarter view facing left with its head turned towards the viewer: root on the ground; body with neck (belly squash on the body); head on the neck, face with eyes and brows (the mouth on the head, with the drawn nose, so a face turn never parts them); earL/earR behind the head (flick); far legs (legFF/legBF, own pieces) behind the body, shaded; near legs (legFN/legBN) in front of the body, their tops faded into its fur (fadeTop) so no outline shows at the joint; little tail at the rump (wags).

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a fawn character standing on all four legs, its head turned towards the viewer. Draw this exact fawn as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, fur texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the head: the fawn's head turned towards the viewer as in image 1, with its black nose and its rosy cheeks, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyelashes, no mouth — keep the nose, the rosy cheeks and the lighter fur round the eyes and muzzle; without ears and without any neck: the head ends at the chin and jaw, its bottom edge the smooth rounded line of the jaw and the back of the head, nothing hanging below it.
2. the body: the spotted fawn body with its neck and cream chest, white spots on the back, seen from the side as in image 1, without head, without tail and without any legs: no legs, no shoulders, no thighs and no haunches drawn on it — its underside one smooth rounded line from the chest to the rump; the top of the neck, normally under the head, rounded.
3. the near front leg: the front leg of image 1 that starts on the side of the chest (the second leg from the left), drawn whole from the top of the shoulder down to the dark hoof: the broad shoulder and upper leg, tapering into the slender lower leg and its dark hoof; straight, as in image 1; its top a soft, full, rounded curve of fur.
4. the near back leg: the back leg of image 1 on the far right, drawn whole from the top of the haunch down to the dark hoof: the big rounded thigh (the whole haunch at the rump, as big as it is in image 1), the bent hock, the slender lower leg and its dark hoof; its top a soft, full, rounded curve of fur.
5. the far front leg: the leftmost leg of image 1, under the cream chest, drawn whole from a rounded top down to the dark hoof, slender, as in image 1.
6. the far back leg: the back leg of image 1 under the belly (the third leg from the left), drawn whole from a rounded thigh top down to the dark hoof, slender with its bent hock, as in image 1.
7. the left ear: the big pointed ear on the left of image 1, with its pink inside and dark rim, with a rounded base.
8. the right ear: the big pointed ear on the right of image 1, with its pink inside and dark rim, with a rounded base.
9. the tail: the little white fluffy tail with its orange back, raised as in image 1, with a rounded base.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a fawn character; image 2 shows the same fawn cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the fawn's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the fawn in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the fawn's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle and its little eyelashes at the outer corner.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle and eyelashes.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with its eyelashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc with its eyelashes.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle, with its eyelashes.
6. a small thin dark-brown eyebrow: a short soft arc.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile line, on its own, without the nose.
8. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink, without the nose.
9. the mouth open in a small round 'o', without the nose.
10. the mouth in a small sad frown, without the nose.

The nose is already on the head in image 2: never draw a nose, the mouths are the mouth lines alone.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the fawn lowers its head to nibble the grass, then lifts it, flicks its ears, wags its little white tail and looks around brightly.

pause.shows: the fawn with its head down, nibbling the grass

animations.description: the fawn walks along to the left on its slender legs, then stops.
the fawn flicks one big ear, then the other, listening.
the fawn wags its little white tail happily.
the fawn prances on the spot, springing up on all four legs, three bouncy little leaps.
the fawn crouches, jumps up high for joy and lands with a little squash.
the fawn stretches its nose forward and sniffs, sniffs, sniffs.
the fawn lifts a front hoof and taps the ground with it, tap, tap.
the fawn lifts its head high and gazes up at the sky, then looks back down with a smile.

pause.shows: the fawn with its head lifted high, gazing up at the sky

animations.description: the fawn frowns and stamps a front hoof crossly on the ground, stamp, stamp.
